messages:
alyssa: Heads-up: we got a DSAR asking for account erasure plus proof of deletion for messages and embeddings tied to an email. It references an activity window in 2023. We need to confirm if embeddings live in a managed vector DB snapshot or ephemeral bucket.
legal-bot: DSAR #721 received from privacy-portal. SLA 30d. Artifacts requested: delete logs, embedding store TTL policy, KMS key version metadata.
kevin: embeddings are in `vecstore-prod` (hosted vector DB) and also we used to export periodic backups to `gs://embeddings-backups/` until 2023-08 when we switched to ephemeral TTLed stores. need to check which path applies.
nate: quick pointer: backup exports were encrypted with `projects/redwood-keystore` keyring; after 2023-09 we rotated to `projects/redwood-keystore-v2`. we kept old versions but disabled them for new signings.
alyssa: legal wants cryptographic proof of inaccessibility. can we provide log-based evidence and metadata that key versions are disabled for the older backups?
kevin: we have KMS audit logs showing `cryptoKeyVersions.destroy` for one version in 2024-03 (test destroy), but production versions were only disabled, not destroyed. destroyed versions would break decryption for anyone.
ate: RBAC check: who could have exported backups? need list of principals with `roles/storage.objects.create` on embeddings bucket and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on keyring. I suspect `backup-operator@` SA and some oncall accounts.
ops-bot: Retention reminder: project logs -> 365d. Embeddings export date is 2023-07. if we didn't export logs to archive, we may not have full payloads.
alyssa: immediate actions:
- verify if the customer's embeddings were in backups or ephemeral store
- if backups, export GCS logs for that bucket for 2023-06..2023-08 window
- export KMS audit for key versions in that period
- collect IAM policy snapshots for 24 months
- create sealed evidence bundle and record sha256 in secure vault
- avoid destructive key ops unless legal & security approve
kevin: running exports now. command snippets: ```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND resource.labels.bucket_name="embeddings-backups" AND protoPayload.methodName:("storage.objects.create" OR "storage.objects.delete")' --start-time="2023-06-01T00:00:00Z" --end-time="2023-09-01T00:00:00Z" --format=json > /tmp/emb_backup_logs.json
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_crypto_key_version" AND protoPayload.methodName:("DestroyCryptoKeyVersion" OR "DisableCryptoKeyVersion")' --start-time="2023-06-01T00:00:00Z" --end-time="2024-06-01T00:00:00Z" --format=json > /tmp/emb_kms_logs.json
```
nate: RBAC export: `gsutil ls gs://infra-policy-archive/2023-*/ | xargs -I {} gsutil cp {}/policy.json /tmp/`
alyssa: also mark potential evidence with labels to prevent auto-purge: `gsutil label ch -l privacy.dsar=721 gs://embeddings-backups/*`
kevin: uploaded exports to `gs://evidence-dsar-721/` and computed sha256 `a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0` (full signed hash in vault).
legal-bot: DSAR #721 updated: initial artifacts received. Next update requested by 2024-10-20 12:00 UTC.
alyssa: per policy we should provide a redacted copy of logs to requester with salted hashes proving deletion timing and hashes of the artifacts we put in the vault. legal to confirm redaction rules.
nate: chuck: any requirement to rotate keys to show inaccessibility? we should avoid that. provide KMS audit extracts showing key state and admin actions.
kevin: I attached a redacted snippet showing `storage.objects.delete` for an embedding export file: 
```json
{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"storage.objects.delete","authenticationInfo":{"principalEmail":"backup-operator@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"},"resourceName":"projects/_/buckets/embeddings-backups/objects/backup-20230701.tar.gz"}}
```
ops-bot: Reminder: All DSAR artifacts must be PGP signed by sec lead before sharing externally.
alyssa: thanks. legal will draft reply referencing sec-signed artifacts and archive hash. Keep thread updated when the signed bundle is uploaded.
kevin: done. bundle uploaded. sha256 in vault.
legal-bot: DSAR #721 closed: response delivered. Case: no hold requested.
alyssa: nice work. documenting for postmortem and process improvement: - we should ensure monthly export retention includes critical buckets with longer retention for at least 24 months when backups existed. file a follow-up ticket to update infra archive policy.
ops-bot: Follow-up ticket created: INFRA-2246 `increase archive retention for backups exported pre-2024`.
